Messages.Author: evil_poot_cat
Messages.Body:
Timlagor <Timlagor...@yahoo.com> wrote in message news:<MPG.19c6658f5...@news.freeserve.com>...

> Anyone want to write a quick rundown on bloating (or just pool-gain)
> techniques?
> What's your preferred method?

I'm still partial to the Blood Tears/Blood Doll module, for
small-midcap decks without fortitude, but I'll take any pool gain I
can get. Example: Ghivran Dalaal (Ravnos 5-cap) is an anarch with
one blood and a palatial estate. During untap and master phase, he
gets one from his Palatial Estate, I tap The Coven (as passed from the
left) for two, move one blood over from a Firebrand, Minion Tap him
for five. He hunts this turn, next turn he gets another from
Palatial, plays superior Restoration, and is full again, ready for
another Tap if needed. wheeeee!

If I have to minion tap a 5- or 6-cap, so be it. I'll even play
Ascendance if I have extra master slots (rare, but it happens). Con
Boon/Bribes is good for at least one pool. :) Sudden pool gain in
mid-game can be enough to give a predator incentive to start worrying
about his own skin a bit more than yours.

I also like Powerbase: Montreal in combination with Dreams, Art Museum
(or similar), and/or Info. Highway.

One more note: I categorize bleed reduction as a roundabout form of
pool gain.

Basically, It's just a matter of making room in the library for pool
gain, because any deck can bloat a little bit.

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
"Eric Freeman" <eric...@hotmail.com> wrote in message news:<xpj7b.10590$Ly2.1...@cletus.bright.net>...


Perhaps because of this problem: Embraces now come into play as 1-caps
with no discipline card. So when you Tribute to the Master, all your
Embraces are empty, and must hunt before you have a chance to Patshiv
(or to Blood Feast if you're talking about Sabbat Clans). And then
when you do get the Patshiv off, they're already full and the blood
generated is lost (even if they were all untapped, which they aren't
because they all hunted.)

And it's not *that* effective of a combination to keep putting
discipline cards on Embraces, because that reduces the number of
master phase actions you have to Tribute with.

Tributes still work fine with Progeny/Creation Rites though; Creation
Rites/Tribute/Blood Feast can work well for bloating.

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: Guzmo
Messages.Body:
Timlagor <Timlagor...@yahoo.com> wrote in message news:<MPG.19c6658f5...@news.freeserve.com>...

> Anyone want to write a quick rundown on bloating (or just pool-gain)
> techniques?
> What's your preferred method?

- Ridiculous amount of pool gain: Pile of weenies & Tribute to the
master or Consanquineous Boon.

- For constant pool gain: Minion Tap/Blood Doll + refill or Parity
Sifts with cards that let you control your pool.

- Maximum profit without any real (own) loss: Derange+Malkavian
Dementia + Minion Tap + Malkavian Time Auction

- Maximum profit with maximum loss for someone else:
Derange+Dementia+Minion Tap+Golconda

- Pool gain with style points: Rush 8+ cap. Vampire. Burn it. Deamonic
Possession followed next turn with Golconda

- By snakey style: Weenie corruption with Khobar towers

- By very stupid way: Having 10+ Malkavian Games (and Parthenon) on
your deck and being very very lucky!

- By cheating: Let your friend give you 29 pool via Succubus club

- By winning: Table sweep will give you 4 or 5 x 6 pool :P

- Guzmo
